compute_transitive_deps: compute the transitive closure of dependencies for a given node using depth-first traversal
run_mako_plugin: run the mako plugin to add transitive_deps to all targets in a build dictionary
build_dependency_graph: build a dependency graph from a yaml dictionary and resolve transitive closures for each target
topological_sort_deps: topologically sort dependencies by recursively traversing the lib_map in depth-first order
add_transitive_deps_to_targets: add a transitive_deps property to each target with a deps list in the dictionary
